faq.a: Elifnur is associated with the Arabic form أَلِيف نُور, whose core sense is elifnur; alif of light (turkish).

faq.q: What is the origin of Elifnur?
faq.a: Elifnur is associated with Arabic. Elifnur is a Turkish compound of Arabic أَلِف (alif) + نُور (nūr, 'light').
Yes — the underlying form أَلِيف نُور is Arabic.
Elifnur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Elifnur should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.

faq.q: What does Elifnur mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Elifnur is rendered الف نور and carries the sense الف نور، نور کا الف.

faq.q: What does Elifnur mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Elifnur is rendered الف نور and carries the sense الف نور، الف نور.
A romanized syllable approximation is e-lif-nur. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Elifnur?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Elifnur, elifnur. Script forms are أَلِيف نُور, الف نور, एलिफ़ नूर.

faq.q: Is Elifnur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
